reason: I've opened my college Outlook like twice this semester and I still get by, because the class WhatsApp group tells me when something actually matters. I might install it if the uni pushes it, but between fests, club work and practice I'd forget it exists within two weeks.
objection: It's going to ping me for every random circular and notice, I'll get annoyed and mute it or delete it. Another app with alerts is the last thing I need.
would_change_my_mind: If it only alerted me for things that actually affect me, like my own exam dates and assignment deadlines, and my friends were all using it, so missing it meant missing stuff.
